pages.title: Herbs & Harvest
pages.text: Herbs & Harvest focuses on artisanal food production — cured meats, aged cheeses, fermented products, and herb-seasoned dishes. Its biggest contribution to Nourished is $(bold)Dairy$(), where it finally gives that group rotation options beyond plain milk.

pages.title: Dairy — Aged Cheeses
pages.text:
Herbs & Harvest adds aged cheese varieties, each a distinct dairy family:

$(bold)Aged Swiss$() — medium aging time; balanced nutrition.
$(bold)Aged Cheddar$() — sharp flavour; high nutrition density.
$(bold)Aged Brie$() — slow to produce but very high dairy value.

All three significantly outperform plain milk bucket in nutrition per item. Worth crafting once your dairy farm is established.

pages.title: Proteins — Cured Meats
pages.text:
Herbs & Harvest adds cured and seasoned meats that count as Proteins:

$(bold)Cured Ham$() — aged pork; high protein density.
$(bold)Smoked Salmon$() — a distinct fish family separate from plain cooked salmon.
$(bold)Herb-Seasoned Beef$() — cooked beef with herbs; improved nutrition over plain.

These give Proteins players more rotation variety and higher per-item nutrition.

pages.title: Herbs & Seasoning
pages.text:
The herb system in Herbs & Harvest can apply to many foods across groups. Seasoned variants of plain foods often have:

— Higher nutrition per item
— Slower diminishing returns (as a distinct family)
— Additional minor effects (saturation, speed)

Investing in herb farming pays off in higher food quality across multiple groups simultaneously.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.text:
The earliest Herbs & Harvest addition to pursue for Nourished is the cheese process — milk a cow, follow the cheese aging recipe chain, and unlock the first multi-family dairy rotation.

Parallel to that, planting an herb garden gives seasoning options that improve almost every food group. A small herb plot is one of the best early investments when this mod is installed.
